purpose: The vendored Finsweet Cookie Consent UI: a banner plus a four-row preference modal.

props.title: "Cookie settings" on both the banner and the modal
props.body: one sentence with an inline privacy-policy link
props.categories: exactly 4 - Strictly necessary (always active, non-interactive), Marketing, Personalization, Analytics

behaviour: The head <style> block ships [fs-cc="banner"|"manager"|"preferences"|"interaction"] {display:none}; the banner then ships an inline display:flex and the preferences panel an inline display:none. public/motion/m30.js reveals .cookies over 0.8s power2.out. The embedded <form id="ck-form" method="get"> carries a data-turnstile-sitekey attribute and is INERT in this clone - no Finsweet runtime and no Turnstile script are loaded.

responsive.base: fixed banner plus a centred modal over a scrim

notes: VENDORED THIRD PARTY. All four of its colours are namespaced vendor.cookie-* so that #146ef5, #468df7, #f8f8f8 and #0000001a are never mistaken for Fourmula brand values.
